name: sparx — Catering (Events & Weddings)
tagline: A refined, seasonal template for events caterers — book tastings online from day one.
description: An elegant events-and-wedding catering site — a warm-cream palette, a deep saffron primary and a sage accent under a Fraunces serif display, with seasonal food photography carrying the page. Installs a working booking flow: tastings and consultations you book online, three event coordinators you book by name with their own hours, and a tasting-deposit policy credited to your event. Ships as "Saffron & Sage Catering", a from-scratch seasonal kitchen for weddings and events.
